new order for supply of **Coated Line Pipes worth ~Rs 960 cr** from its **Little Rock, USA** facility _(~2.3% of mcap)_, taking the consolidated global **order book past Rs 25,750 cr (~US$ 2.7 bn) — the strongest in the company's history** — scheduled for execution over FY27–FY28.

order from **Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Prasaran Nigam (RVPNL)** for a **132/33 kV, 2×50 MVA GIS substation at Pal, Jodhpur** plus the associated transmission line (survey, supply, erection, testing & commissioning), **Rs 75.05 cr** _(~5.0% of mcap)_. **WeWork India (WEWORK)** — ICRA **upgrade**, **[ICRA]A (Stable) → A+ (Stable)** on ~Rs 501 cr term loans (plus overdraft, bank-guarantee and unallocated limits).

business_updates: **Results season** — **~250 companies** filed results / earnings-call material today (Q1 FY27 results, press releases, transcripts, presentations — Wipro, Tata Elxsi, Happiest Minds, Balaji Amines, Coal India, TVS Motor, Cipla, Shriram Finance, IndusInd Bank, many more) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here. **Aelea Commodities** — Q1 FY27 update: **~Rs 108 cr invoicing** with **Q2 production capacity already 81% booked** (unaudited operational metrics).

**Accord Transformer & Switchgear (ACCORDTS)** — Q1 FY27 business update covering order book, capacity, vendor approvals and expansion (order-book/revenue figures, not a fresh order).
**Jeena Sikho Lifecare (JSLL)** — launches new **pain-relief patch products** (back/knee/large formats), extending its healthcare & wellness portfolio.
**Valiant Communications** — announces a **zero-day-attack mitigation solution** (product/technology update).
**LTM Ltd** — partners with **Cognition (Devin)** to reduce cyber risk in financial services.

**Simbhaoli Sugars** — post-facto intimation of the **1st Committee-of-Creditors meeting** (CIRP underway).

other_notable: **Debt — dropped per §3, never movers:** Cube Highways Trust's Rs 5,000 cr and Capri Global's Rs 1,462 cr NCD programmes; Tata Power's "Issue of Securities" (NCD); MAS Financial's NCD allotment; Union Bank's Rs 1,320 cr bond-coupon certificate.
**Coal India (COALINDIA)** — approves an **investment in the rights issue of subsidiary CIL Rajasthan Akshay Urja (CRAUL)** — intra-group funding, not a fresh raise.

tally: 2026-07-27: 1,253 announcements captured (07:22–23:12 IST), 272 material rows in the baseline → ~48 curated lines after review. It was a heavy results day (~250 companies reporting), which the digest collapses to one line. The genuine movers were two large export orders the RSS feed hid inside press notes — **Sigma Advanced's ~Rs 1,013 cr artillery-shell order** and **Welspun Corp's ~Rs 960 cr coated-pipes order (record Rs 25,750 cr book)** — plus two mid-caps, **Rajesh Power's Rs 75.05 cr RVPNL substation** and **Highway Infra's Rs 28.69 cr toll-plaza contract**. The raw baseline's other "movers" were artefacts: Nimbus' Rs 40 cr / Rs 23 cr are ICICI **term loans** (debt), Digitide's Rs 775 cr and Tilaknagar's Rs 1,046 cr are Q1 **revenue**, Accord/Aelea/HRS's Rs 108–159 cr are **business-update metrics**, Highway Infra's Rs 200.88 cr is a **rated facility**, and Emkay/Nurture Well/Senores' Rs 227–500 cr are **monitoring reports**. Real thematic signal: Bondada's 225 MW solar-IPP acquisition, Heritage Foods' PBJL control buy, Mankind's Rs 49 cr Broadway divestment, Somany's NCLT-approved subsidiary amalgamation, and rating upgrades (JSW Steel to Moody's investment grade Baa3, WeWork India ICRA A→A+, GE Vernova and Jindal Steel upgrades) against Shalby's ICRA downgrade to A.
